steps.title: Download all 63,053 masks (~4.3 GB)
steps.note: Full download running (8 workers, started 2026-10-27; ~5-7 h). Resumable: rerun python3 src/download_masks.py. 502 chambers; 20-22 visits each.

steps.title: Reproduce the lab's published numbers
steps.note: Part 1 done for group 1 (e1330b3): lab's contact area reproduced from masks; 28/33 paper rows match a chamber within 0.5%, 4 probable, 1 ambiguous. Map in results/. Other 12 experiments queued as downloads finish. Next: generalize the row mapping; part 2 (actin flow) needs raw volumes.

steps.title: Build per-cell death labels
steps.note: Plan: use the deposited 2D dead-dye projections (MIPxy_405 / MIPxz_405, ~130 kB each, ~1.4 GB per view for one sweep per visit) inside the target mask, following the lab's dead_count.m rule. Avoids 700+ GB of raw volumes.

steps.title: Describe every chamber, and 10-20 in depth

steps.note: Descriptors vs death time and donor, all chambers. Decides what step 6 is for.
